title: An AI-assisted audit found eight maintainer-confirmed software regressions
summary: An audit of 1,459 merged pull requests in four Python projects used language models to generate behavior checks. The study found nine reproducible regression candidates, of which eight were confirmed by maintainers. The result concerns a targeted software audit.
ai_technology: ORION; learned test generation and behavioral oracles
organization: Beihang University; National University of Singapore

source_review.scope: v1 ORION design and §V-E real-world regression evaluation

evidence.tested: ORION flagged 28 requests. The authors retained and manually reviewed currently reproducible warnings before submitting nine candidates for maintainer confirmation.
evidence.unknown: The reviewers did not comprehensively assess unflagged changes, so recall and general defect rates are unknown. This is not a count of security vulnerabilities.
evidence.ai_role: ORION uses a learned model to infer intended software behavior and generate checks for regression candidates in existing projects.
